authorization: DESIGN ONLY; no runtime or harness changes authorized by this audit
justification: One nonempty real update fills every scoped Adam optimizer and makes ValueNorm/progression nontrivial; one real post-load update proves usable restored state. Repeated in-process rollover is already demonstrated, so neither 3+3 nor another normal-horizon campaign is logically necessary.

configuration.environment_horizon: A frozen previously qualified checkpoint-focused fixture may be reused; not a new normal-horizon proof.

A: Fresh real process/learner; LR position1 before rollout; one update p=1 through S10; populate all actor/critic Adam; snapshot at declared LR boundary and atomic strict save; clean exit.
B: Fresh real process/learner; strict load before new rollout; exact same-boundary state comparison; use p+1=2 of12, then one real update; completed=2, next/LR position=3; S10 and clean exit.
minimum_precondition: All actors must have nonempty Adam and participate in the chosen first rollout. If absent, reject the fixture/precondition; do not dynamically expand runtime without approval.

gates.assertion: Same effective fixed-scale event configuration and source in A/B; separate fresh OS processes; no old learner reuse or pure-import namespace pollution.
A completes one real S0-S10 update, every actor Adam and critic Adam populated, ValueNorm nontrivial, all required learner state finite; expected counts come from each frozen plan.
Save only at actual S10: no partial update, poison, pending permits, gradients, active optimizer/load or writer. Save does not change learner state.
One complete checkpoint generation atomically published and strictly validated, including all models/Adam/VN/progression/effective semantic configuration.
A exits and becomes inactive; parent requires durable semantic success plus validated checkpoint, never exit code alone, before launching B.

B strictly loads before collecting/training; all model tensors, Adam groups/moments/steps, VN fields and progression equal A's same-boundary snapshot, with correct device placement (ordinary Adam scalar step may stay CPU).
B uses saved next update p+1 and saved total horizon; nonzero expected LR from original base LR, applied before pre-collection fingerprint; no scheduler restart or LR mutation inside collection.

One fresh B rollout and real S0-S10 update succeeds under reviewed event-return/DVM contracts; plan-derived actor and critic Adam deltas match actual steps and do not reset; legitimate zero-plan actors remain unchanged.
B ValueNorm progresses from the loaded state with exactly planned updates; completed/next/LR position advances once; all required learner/optimizer state remains finite.
B ends at S10, environment/application close and worker inactivity established; durable core results suffice to adjudicate, with no uncontrolled further update/retry.

not_required: matching stochastic B trajectory to uninterrupted A

repair_policy.verdict: SAFE WITH CORE-EVIDENCE AND AUTHORITY QUALIFICATIONS
repair_policy.before_first_mutation: Clearly local harness/path/type/serialization/receipt corrections may be made under explicit final-run authority, logged and source-frozen again, with focused preflight. Recreate runtime process if imports or construction were contaminated. No new numbered phase needed.
repair_policy.after_mutation: Never hot-patch active learner/harness, reinterpret expectations, or retry an update. Stop on semantic/checkpoint/restore/Adam/VN/progression failures AND when missing/ambiguous required core evidence prevents safe adjudication. Diagnostic-only publication failures may be repaired offline from immutable sufficient raw evidence; they do not automatically poison a valid S10 learner.
repair_policy.poison: Use actual incomplete/ambiguous mutation or failed rollback, not any report error. If safety cannot be proved, stop and discard; preserve the failed attempt.
repair_policy.not_blanket_permission: Do not make or execute any such repair/run in this audit; retries beyond reviewed scope require authorization.
